reveal_en: Despite towering mountains and Mariana Trenches, if Earth were scaled down to a billiard ball, it would be proportionally smoother than any actual billiard ball, its largest features barely perceptible.
reveal_zh: 尽管有高山和马里亚纳海沟，若将地球缩小到台球大小，它会比真正的台球更平滑，其最大特征几乎难以察觉。
meaning_en: This reveals how our perception of geological scale is profoundly influenced by our own size and immediate environment.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了我们对地质尺度的感知深受自身大小和即时环境的影响。
